name: The Sun Gallery
description: The corridor opens onto a breathtaking chamber stretching far beyond the reach of your lanterns.
Endless rows of golden grain sway gently beneath brilliant white lights suspended high overhead,
their impossible radiance imitating a summer afternoon. Water flows silently through carefully carved
stone channels while tiny brass constructs continue tending the crop as though their makers had left only yesterday.
Something rustles deep within the wheat. TODO: AI Text

outcomes.text: Amid the trampled wheat lie the shattered husks of the guard drones you felled.
You spend a long while combing the endless rows, but the wheat hides nothing further — only the ceaseless work of the little brass tenders.

success.text: Tracing the channels, you grasp the whole ingenious scheme: meltwater drawn from some deep cistern, filtered through crushed stone, portioned to each row by float-valves that never tire. The system could run untended for centuries — and clearly has.

failure.text: Water runs through the carved channels in a pattern you can't quite follow, feeding the endless rows by some logic that escapes you.

outcomes.text: You pick through the wreckage of the drones. Scored brass plating, spent power cells, and the faint smell of ozone — but nothing you can carry off.
